job.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
job.description:
Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist

Location: Remote – candidates must be local to Southern California
Contract: 3 months
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Pay Rate: $35.14 per hour

We are seeking an experienced Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter to support full-cycle recruitment across a broad range of technical, engineering and corporate functions.

This role will act as a strategic recruiting partner to hiring managers and business leaders, helping identify, attract and hire high-quality talent across areas including IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Enterprise Security, Customer Service, Operations and Finance.

The successful candidate will bring at least five years of full-cycle recruiting experience, strong sourcing capabilities and a consultative approach to working with hiring managers. Experience recruiting complex technical or hard-to-fill positions is particularly valuable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead full-cycle recruitment across technical, engineering and corporate positions, from initial intake and sourcing through offer and hire.

  • Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies to identify both active and passive candidates.

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand requirements, establish expectations and develop effective recruiting strategies.

  • Provide consultative guidance using recruiting data, talent market intelligence and competitive insights.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for technical and hard-to-fill positions.

  • Create effective job postings and recruitment marketing strategies to attract qualified candidates.

  • Conduct candidate screening and qualification against technical and business requirements.

  • Manage requisitions and recruiting workflows within SuccessFactors or similar enterprise applicant tracking systems.

  • Partner with HR Business Partners, Compensation, Benefits and other internal stakeholders to provide a consistent candidate and hiring experience.

  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable employment regulations.

  • Analyse recruiting metrics and labour market trends to identify opportunities to improve hiring outcomes.

  • Develop strong relationships with hiring managers, business leaders and relevant talent communities.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including sourcing, candidate screening, job posting development and recruitment strategy.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing proactive candidate sourcing strategies.

  • Experience partnering directly with hiring managers throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

  • Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple requisitions and competing priorities within a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong understanding of recruiting technologies, sourcing tools and applicant tracking systems.

  • Ability to interpret recruiting data and translate findings into practical recommendations.

  • Knowledge of applicable federal and state employment laws and recruiting compliance requirements.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience recruiting technical, IT and engineering talent.

  • Previous responsibility for niche or difficult-to-fill positions.

  • Experience recruiting across multiple corporate job families.

  • Experience using the SuccessFactors Recruiting Module.

  • Experience with talent intelligence and advanced sourcing platforms.

  • Bachelor's degree.

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced recruiter who enjoys combining hands-on sourcing and full-cycle recruitment with strategic hiring manager partnership.

Please note: This position is remote, but candidates must be located in Southern California and able to collect company-provided equipment.

job.title: Prototype Analyst
job.description:
Prototype Analyst

Location: Irvine, CA – Hybrid (3–4 days onsite per week)
Contract: 6 months
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Pay Rate: $45.24 per hour

We are seeking a Prototype Analyst to support prototype vehicle builds within a fast-paced automotive engineering environment. This position will play a key role in maintaining accurate product and parts data throughout the build process, working closely with engineering, warehouse and partner teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Master Parts List (MPL) management, Product Data Management (PDM) and data analysis, with the ability to manage complex engineering information and identify discrepancies across multiple systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain and validate Master Parts Lists (MPLs) for prototype builds in collaboration with internal engineering teams and external partners.

  • Perform regular Bill of Materials (BOM) to MPL alignment checks to ensure accurate and consistent product data.

  • Partner with Prototype Engineering to incorporate process and engineering data into the MPL.

  • Conduct regular MPL validations throughout the build lifecycle.

  • Manage engineering changes by reviewing, approving and executing Change Management (CM) tickets.

  • Analyse, debug and correlate data transferred between engineering and production systems.

  • Work closely with warehouse teams to maintain accurate visibility of part availability.

  • Support part shortage meetings and provide clear updates on critical or constrained components.

  • Participate in deviation meetings and ensure approved changes are accurately reflected within the MPL.

  • Track and communicate part status throughout prototype builds.

  • Support Change Review Boards (CRBs) and help implement last-minute engineering changes when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Data Management or a related discipline.

  • Strong understanding of Product Data Management (PDM).

  • Experience creating, maintaining or validating Master Parts Lists (MPLs) or similar engineering parts structures.

  • Strong data analysis skills with the ability to identify discrepancies across complex datasets.

  • Experience with engineering or product change management processes.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous experience within an automotive, EV or prototype vehicle development environment.

  • Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems.

  • Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems.

  • Understanding of vehicle architecture and systems.

  • Knowledge of electrical systems or wiring harnesses would be particularly beneficial.

This is an excellent opportunity for an analytically minded professional to support complex prototype vehicle builds while working closely with engineering and operations teams in a highly technical automotive environment.

job.title: Data Consultant - Data Remediation and Master Data
job.description:
Master Data Lead

Sydney | Hybrid

Contract

The Opportunity

  • We’re partnering with a leading large-scale consumer organisation on a high-priority data remediation initiative supporting several major technology and transformation programs.
  • We’re looking for an experienced Master Data Lead to assess the current data landscape, identify and diagnose data-quality issues, and establish a clear remediation roadmap and longer-term governance approach.
  • This is a hands-on consulting role, combining strong technical data investigation with Master Data expertise and senior stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead an end-to-end diagnostic of Master Data quality across multiple interconnected systems.
  • Profile large datasets to identify outdated, duplicated, incomplete and incorrectly configured records.
  • Perform data mapping, cleansing, validation, issue categorisation and root-cause analysis.
  • Assess and rationalise complex legacy Master Data.
  • Investigate parent-child and hierarchical data structures and identify inconsistencies impacting downstream processes.
  • Trace data flows across source systems, operational platforms, integrations and reporting environments.
  • Use SQL to interrogate data across multiple relational tables and identify underlying issues.
  • Identify the root cause and downstream business impact of data-quality problems.
  • Assess cross-system identifiers and contribute to a more consistent target-state data structure.
  • Help establish a longer-term Master Data governance framework and operating model.

Skillset

  • Strong experience across Master Data Management, Data Remediation, Data Quality and Data Governance.
  • Experience within retail, FMCG, supply chain, consumer or another high-volume operational environment
  • Strong SQL capability and confidence working hands-on with complex relational datasets.
  • Experience with data profiling, mapping, cleansing, validation and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience rationalising large or complex legacy datasets.
  • Strong understanding of parent-child / hierarchical Master Data structures.
  • Experience investigating data issues across multiple interconnected platforms.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into clear business and operational impacts.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to independently lead a diagnostic/remediation workstream from problem identification through to recommendations and execution planning.

job.title: Substation Project Engineer (Remote)
job.description:
Location: Remote (U.S.A)

Schedule: Full-time, standard office hours on East Coast time (EST)

Duration: 12 Month W2 Contract

Pay Rate: $38.00 – $42.00/hr (W2)

Position Summary

Our client, a leading U.S. utility company, is seeking an Engineer – Substation to join its Engineering & Construction Business Unit on a 12-month W2 contract. This is a fully remote position supporting a team based in Juno Beach, FL, working standard East Coast (EST) business hours. The role owns assigned substation projects from conception (Early Stage) through construction and commissioning (Execution), working closely with development, supply chain, transmission, estimating, and external engineers of record. Some travel is required within North America.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • All assigned substation projects from conception (Early Stage) through construction and commissioning (Execution).
  • In the conceptual phase, you will work with the Early-Stage Project Manager to support the engineering requirements and scope with the Development Group.
  • Training, due diligence, and technical oversight of external engineers of record (EOR) for all assigned substation projects to ensure compliance with required generation interconnection agreements, scope of work documents, project specifications, site specific design requirements, IEEE, NESC, ASCE and all other applicable industry codes and standards.
  • Securing engineering consulting resources from a list of approved suppliers by developing a scope of work, securing bids, evaluating, and awarding work through the client's Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) Group.
  • Coordinate with other project stakeholders to develop and secure a substation site, support any engineering updates, data and permits necessary to design and build the substation.
  • Competitively source, select and contract geotechnical, survey, engineering, and construction services, and support the E&C Cost Estimating Team with scope assumptions.
  • Coordination with other groups to ensure that the assigned E&C substation projects are successful. Generally responsible for representing E&C's internal and external interests on assigned projects, including presentations/briefings on current progress, issues, and risk mitigation in meetings with various levels of management.
  • Support Transmission Services during review of interconnection documentation including system impact studies, facility studies, reactive and harmonic studies and Interconnection agreements, and ensure that Transmission Owner requirements and E&C engineering design are consistent and in compliance with all ISO requirements and incorporated into the project design. Must be able to work with and communicate often with the respective transmission owners/operators/ISOs to ensure project deliverables will meet specific off-taker requirements and are timely and accurate.
  • Manage all project long lead major material orders to minimize risk of delays or exceeding the project budget. Assist ISC with all substation project SOW creation, review, approval, and preparation of shopping carts for engineering services and materials in a timely manner.
  • Support E&C Estimating with template updates via project feedback, technical support, and scope modifications.
  • Work collaboratively with project engineering resources in various disciplines to determine project priorities, work plans and lines of demarcation.
  • Ensure projects are efficiently, cost effectively and safely implemented in accordance with department processes, procedures, industry standards and policies.
  • Support assigned project commissioning activities to meet corporate objectives.
  • Support Legal in any regulatory filings, depositions and/or hearings.
  • Collaborate with component OEMs to enhance/adapt their designs to better integrate with the client's philosophies.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering is preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in substation design and engineering of High Voltage substation projects is highly preferred.
  • Project Engineering and/or Project Management experience, ideally on substation or interconnection projects from the owner or EPC side.
  • PMP and/or P.E. in a related discipline is a plus.

Knowledge/Skills

  • Full-lifecycle project ownership, from early-stage scoping through construction and commissioning.
  • Scope of work development and procurement – writing SOWs, issuing bids, evaluating proposals, and awarding work through a supply chain group.
  • Long-lead material, schedule, and budget management, including scope assumptions and feedback for cost estimating.
  • Risk identification and mitigation, with the ability to surface issues early and brief various levels of management.
  • Vendor and consultant oversight – managing external engineers of record to specifications, codes, and standards.
  • Permitting and site development coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration across development, supply chain, estimating, transmission, legal, OEM, and multi-discipline engineering groups.
  • Clear, frequent communication with transmission owners, operators, and ISOs, plus the negotiation and influencing skills to represent E&C's interests.
  • Strong bias for action – driving decisions and keeping projects moving.
  • High-voltage substation fundamentals and working knowledge of IEEE, NESC, ASCE, and other applicable codes and standards.
  • Interconnection process literacy – reading system impact studies, facility studies, reactive/harmonic studies, and interconnection agreements, and understanding ISO/Transmission Owner requirements.
  • Commissioning and regulatory support, including assisting Legal with filings, depositions, and hearings.
  • Some travel required within North America.

job.title: Compound Manager
job.description:
COMPOUND MANAGER

CAMBRIDGE, MA | STANDARD EST HOURS

DURATION:

12-Month Contract

PAY:

$44-49/Hour Maximum Pay Rate




Job Responsibilities: In this role, you will support Medicinal Chemistry and Discovery Research Operations by managing the registration, receipt, storage, distribution, inventory, and quality oversight of chemical compounds supporting discovery research. Key responsibilities include:

· Managing the registration and documentation of newly synthesized and externally sourced chemical compounds.

· Maintaining accurate compound metadata, inventory records, sample history, and electronic documentation.

· Ensuring compound availability, traceability, sample integrity, and accurate inventory control.

· Coordinating domestic and international compound shipments and transfers to internal and external collaborators.

· Partnering with Medicinal Chemistry, Biology, DMPK, Analytical Sciences, Informatics, and external CROs to support research activities.

· Developing and maintaining SOPs, work instructions, and training materials for compound management workflows.

· Investigating inventory, labeling, shipping, and database discrepancies and supporting corrective actions.

· Driving continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, turnaround time, data integrity, and user experience.

· Serving as an operational point of contact for CROs and vendors supporting compound synthesis, purification, analytical testing, storage, and logistics.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

· Register newly synthesized and externally sourced compounds in electronic compound databases according to established registration and nomenclature standards.

· Maintain complete and accurate information related to chemical structure, molecular weight, purity, salt form, inventory location, and sample history.

· Conduct routine inventory audits and reconcile physical inventory against electronic records.

· Investigate and resolve discrepancies between physical samples and database records.

· Maintain accurate compound inventory and ensure research materials are available to project teams when needed.

· Coordinate domestic and international shipments and transfers while following applicable regulations and company policies.

· Create, implement, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and training documentation.

· Investigate deviations involving inventory, labeling, shipping, and database records.

· Drive actions designed to prevent recurring operational issues.

· Lead or contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on workflow efficiency, scalability, turnaround time, and data integrity.

· Manage day-to-day operational relationships with CROs and vendors.

· Partner with project teams, procurement, and quality functions to resolve vendor and collaboration issues.

· Support vendor onboarding, performance discussions, process changes, and business-continuity planning.

· Partner with medicinal chemists to ensure timely registration and processing of newly synthesized compounds.

· Collaborate with Biology, DMPK, Informatics, Analytical Chemistry, and project teams to support study execution and compound logistics.

· Train laboratory personnel and external partners on compound submission requirements, systems, and best practices.

· Serve as a subject-matter expert for compound management systems, processes, and data standards.

Knowledge & Skills:

· Strong knowledge of chemical structures, nomenclature, compound handling, storage, and laboratory safety practices.

· Experience with compound registration platforms, electronic laboratory systems, and inventory management databases.

· Experience with compound registration software such as BIOVIA, Dotmatics, CDD Vault, ChemAxon, or equivalent platforms.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and database or inventory-tracking applications.

· Some experience with Python scripting preferred.

· Familiarity with automated compound storage and retrieval systems preferred.

· Knowledge of high-throughput screening support preferred.

· Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and record-keeping skills.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and sample integrity.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced research environment.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, external CROs, and vendors.

· Strong practical problem-solving skills and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Education & Experience:

· Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a related scientific discipline required.

· Master's degree or equivalent experience preferred.

· At least 3 years of relevant experience in compound management, medicinal chemistry support, pharmaceutical research operations, or a related scientific environment.

· Hands-on experience with compound registration platforms, electronic laboratory systems, and inventory management databases.

· Experience working with external CROs, vendors, or compound logistics networks.

job.title: Senior Data Tester
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Data Tester with strong Snowflake, SQL, Apache Airflow and test automation experience to join our data and technology team within a leading financial services organisation.

You’ll play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, integrity and reliability of critical data across modern cloud data platforms and data pipelines.

Working closely with data engineers, developers, analysts and business stakeholders, you’ll design and execute testing strategies across complex data pipelines, with a strong focus on automated data validation and pipeline quality.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute comprehensive data testing and quality assurance strategies across enterprise data platforms.
  • Perform ETL/ELT, data warehouse, data pipeline and integration testing.
  • Write complex SQL to validate data transformations, reconciliations, business rules and data quality.
  • Test data within Snowflake, including tables, views, stored procedures and transformation logic.
  • Validate data ingestion and transformation across source and target systems.
  • Work with Apache Airflow to understand, test and validate data pipeline workflows, DAGs, dependencies and scheduling.
  • Develop automated tests and validation checks that can be integrated into Airflow pipelines and CI/CD processes.
  • Implement automated data quality checks covering areas such as completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, referential integrity and reconciliation.
  • Validate pipeline execution, including successful/failed DAG runs, dependencies, retries, error handling and downstream impacts.
  • Investigate data issues by tracing failures through Airflow workflows, source systems and Snowflake transformations.
  • Identify opportunities to replace manual testing with repeatable and automated test processes.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated regression test suites for data pipelines.
  • Integrate automated testing into the broader CI/CD and DevOps lifecycle.
  • Identify, investigate and document defects, working closely with engineering teams through to resolution.
  • Support regression, system integration and end-to-end testing.
  • Review technical and business requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios and automated validation rules.

About You

You’ll be a hands-on data testing professional who understands both data quality and modern data engineering practices. You’ll be comfortable working with large datasets, investigating complex pipeline issues and building automation that improves confidence in data releases.

You’ll ideally have:

  • 8+ years’ experience in data testing, ETL testing, data quality or data engineering QA.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake.
  • Strong Python automation experience.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience querying and validating large datasets.
  • Practical experience with Apache Airflow, including DAGs, task dependencies, scheduling, monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing and implementing automated data tests and data quality checks.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouses, data modelling and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Experience testing complex data pipelines and integrations across multiple systems.
  • Experience with Python or another programming language used for test automation.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests can be incorporated into the software/data delivery lifecycle.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience within banking, financial services, insurance or another regulated environment is highly desirable.

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating automated tests with Airflow.
  • Exposure to AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  • Understanding of financial data, regulatory reporting or risk data.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

job.title: Civil & Structural Engineer (Power Generation)
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Civil & Structural Engineer to support the development and execution of complex power generation projects, including gas turbine generation, solar PV, and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

This role will provide technical leadership and oversight across civil, structural, and geotechnical engineering activities throughout the full project lifecycle — from development and engineering through construction and commissioning.

The Civil & Structural Engineer will serve as a key technical representative, coordinating with EPC contractors, engineering consultants, equipment vendors, and internal project teams to ensure designs are technically sound, constructible, code-compliant, and aligned with project cost and schedule objectives.

What You’ll Do

Civil Engineering & Site Development

  • Coordinate and oversee civil engineering activities performed by EPC contractors and engineering consultants.
  • Review site layouts, grading plans, earthwork, roads, drainage systems, and underground utilities.
  • Ensure civil designs meet project requirements and integrate effectively with the overall plant design.
  • Review requirements related to flood protection, stormwater management, erosion control, and site access.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize site layout, grading, and earthwork quantities to reduce cost, schedule, and construction risk.
  • Participate in civil design reviews, value engineering, and constructability assessments.

Structural Engineering

  • Oversee structural engineering activities for power generation and balance-of-plant facilities.
  • Review foundation designs for gas turbines, generators, transformers, and other major equipment.
  • Provide oversight of structural steel, pipe racks, buildings, equipment supports, and structures associated with solar and BESS installations.
  • Review engineering calculations, drawings, and specifications for technical accuracy, constructability, and code compliance.
  • Review geotechnical investigations and ensure recommendations are incorporated appropriately into foundation and structural designs.
  • Coordinate structural interfaces with equipment vendors, including equipment loads, anchor bolts, and embedments.
  • Coordinate structural requirements with mechanical, electrical, and civil engineering disciplines.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable codes and standards, including ASCE 7, ACI 318, and AISC 360, as well as site-specific wind, seismic, and soil conditions.
  • Participate in structural design reviews, value engineering, and constructability assessments.

EPC & Engineering Consultant Oversight

  • Serve as the primary civil and structural engineering coordination lead with EPC contractors.
  • Define scopes of work, review proposals, and oversee the performance of civil, structural, and geotechnical consultants.
  • Monitor the quality, schedule, and budget of EPC and consultant engineering deliverables.
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability reviews, and technical risk assessments.
  • Support the resolution of civil, structural, and geotechnical issues throughout engineering, procurement, and construction.

Regulatory & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Support communications with regulatory authorities and other project stakeholders regarding civil and structural engineering requirements and approvals.
  • Assist with responses to regulatory comments, technical information requests, and stakeholder inquiries.
  • Support public consultation and disclosure activities when required.

Documentation, Reporting & Risk Management

  • Maintain organized records of technical studies, engineering documentation, calculations, drawings, and project correspondence.
  • Provide regular updates on civil and structural engineering progress, issues, and technical risks.
  • Provide civil and structural input into project schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
  • Support development reports, internal project approvals, financing materials, and technical due diligence.
  • Identify and communicate civil, structural, and geotechnical risks that could impact project cost, schedule, or constructability.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 7–10 years of experience supporting civil and structural engineering for power generation, energy, or large industrial infrastructure projects.
  • Experience overseeing or coordinating EPC contractors and engineering consultants.
  • Working knowledge of civil site development, foundations, structural steel, and power generation facilities.
  • Experience reviewing engineering drawings, calculations, specifications, and technical design packages.
  • Strong technical review, project coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with gas turbine power generation, including simple-cycle or combined-cycle facilities.
  • Experience reviewing civil and structural design packages during EPC execution.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.
  • Experience with structural analysis and civil design software such as STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, AutoCAD, or Civil 3D.
  • Experience supporting solar PV and/or BESS projects.

Key Competencies

  • Owner/developer-side EPC and consultant oversight
  • Civil, structural, and geotechnical risk management
  • Power generation and industrial infrastructure
  • Integrated site and plant design coordination
  • Engineering design review and quality assurance
  • Construction constructability and technical risk assessment
  • Engineering code and standards compliance
  • Schedule- and cost-conscious decision-making
  • Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management

job.title: Senior Mechanical Project Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Project Engineer to serve as the owner’s technical authority for the design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operation of multi-unit simple-cycle gas turbine power generation facilities, including associated Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and auxiliary systems.

This role will support the company’s power generation development and execution portfolio and may become dedicated to a specific project site during the execution phase.

The Senior Mechanical Project Engineer will provide engineering leadership from late-stage development through procurement, EPC execution, commissioning, and long-term asset operation. The position will ensure project solutions meet requirements for performance, efficiency, reliability, environmental compliance, operability, and lifecycle cost.

This individual will serve as a key technical interface between the company, equipment OEMs, Owner’s Engineers, EPC contractors, and internal stakeholders, providing owner-side oversight and technical direction throughout the project lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

Owner’s Engineering Leadership – Gas Turbine Projects

  • Serve as the company's mechanical engineering subject matter expert and technical lead for gas turbine generation projects.
  • Provide owner-side technical oversight of major equipment and plant systems, including:
    • Gas turbines
    • Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) systems
    • Heat recovery systems, where applicable
    • Fuel gas systems
    • Lubrication and hydraulic systems
    • Inlet air filtration, conditioning, and cooling systems
    • Exhaust systems, silencers, and stack interfaces
    • Cooling water and heat rejection systems
    • Buildings, enclosures, ventilation, and fire protection
    • Black-start generation systems
  • Ensure equipment and plant designs support long-term availability, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle economics.

Engineering & Design Management

  • Establish and validate design basis, boundary conditions, performance requirements, and equipment specifications.
  • Coordinate technical interfaces between equipment suppliers, EPC contractors, Owner’s Engineers, offtakers, and other stakeholders.
  • Oversee mechanical equipment integration, piping layouts, and balance-of-plant auxiliary systems.
  • Support integration of advanced augmentation technologies and hybrid power configurations.
  • Perform and review feasibility studies, conceptual designs, and engineering analyses, including:
    • Heat and mass balances
    • Thermal performance assessments
    • Water and heat balance calculations
    • Auxiliary and cooling system evaluations
  • Review and validate key engineering deliverables, including equipment datasheets, technical specifications, PFDs, P&IDs, and thermal system documentation.

Project Development & Technology Selection

  • Support project development through technology screening, conceptual design, and performance definition.
  • Evaluate gas turbine technologies and configurations, including simple cycle, combined cycle, CHP, and primary power applications for data centers.
  • Develop owner-level technical requirements, performance guarantees, and specification frameworks for equipment procurement and EPC contracting.
  • Provide technical input into project feasibility, execution strategy, and investment decisions.

Technology Innovation & Optimization

  • Evaluate technologies designed to improve plant efficiency, flexibility, reliability, and emissions performance.
  • Assess turbine power augmentation and inlet air management technologies, including:
    • Mechanical chilling
    • Thermal energy storage
    • Fogging
    • Wet compression
    • Intercooling
    • Absorption chillers
    • Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC)
  • Evaluate advanced auxiliary systems for high-reliability and extreme-climate operating environments.
  • Lead technical evaluations of emissions-control technologies, including SCR and oxidation catalysts.
  • Support decarbonization assessments involving:
    • Hydrogen blending
    • Combined-cycle efficiency improvements
    • Carbon capture readiness and CCUS integration
  • Evaluate impacts of emissions and decarbonization technologies on turbine performance, auxiliary loads, backpressure, permitting, CAPEX, OPEX, and lifecycle economics.

Procurement, Contracting & OEM Management

  • Lead the technical development of RFQs, bid specifications, equipment requirements, and performance guarantees.
  • Conduct technical evaluations of OEM and EPC proposals.
  • Support commercial negotiations and contract development with equipment suppliers and EPC partners.
  • Review vendor deviations, technical exceptions, change orders, warranty provisions, and long-term service agreements.
  • Ensure equipment procurement aligns with project schedule, technical requirements, risk profile, and investment objectives.
  • Develop and maintain strong technical relationships with OEMs, EPC contractors, and major equipment suppliers.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Lead and participate in technical risk assessments, including HAZOP and HAZID studies.
  • Identify and mitigate technical, operational, safety, and reliability risks associated with gas turbine packages and auxiliary systems.
  • Ensure applicable safety, environmental, regulatory, and owner requirements are incorporated throughout design, procurement, construction, and commissioning.
  • Provide technical support for air permitting, emissions modeling, and environmental compliance.

Regulatory & Air Permitting

  • Provide owner-level engineering support for environmental and regulatory requirements associated with gas turbine generation.
  • Support air permit applications and compliance documentation.
  • Provide technical inputs for emissions modeling and control technology evaluations.
  • Maintain awareness of applicable requirements, including:
    • EPA NSPS
    • NESHAP
    • PSD/NSR
    • Local air district permitting
    • Noise and thermal requirements
    • Emerging carbon and decarbonization regulations

EPC Oversight & Project Execution

  • Serve as a member of the owner's project management team during EPC execution.
  • Provide technical oversight of turbine package engineering, fabrication, installation, commissioning, and startup.
  • Review EPC design packages, interface documentation, installation procedures, and commissioning plans.
  • Participate in:
    • Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs)
    • Site Acceptance Tests (SATs)
    • Performance testing
    • Reliability testing
    • Commissioning and startup activities
  • Lead resolution of technical issues, equipment problems, vendor claims, and commissioning challenges.

Asset Lifecycle & Operational Support

  • Provide engineering support to operating generation assets, including troubleshooting, upgrades, outage planning, and performance optimization.
  • Support spare-parts strategies, service planning, and reliability improvement initiatives.
  • Evaluate retrofit and upgrade opportunities related to emissions compliance, output enhancement, efficiency, and long-term asset value.
  • Capture operational lessons learned and incorporate them into future project development and design standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience supporting open-cycle gas turbine power generation projects through development, EPC execution, OEM environments, or owner/operator organizations.
  • Strong technical knowledge of gas turbine packages, turbine auxiliaries, balance-of-plant systems, and equipment integration.
  • Demonstrated experience with engineering design review, equipment procurement, EPC execution, and OEM management.
  • Experience supporting air permitting, emissions compliance, and environmental control systems.
  • Strong understanding of project development, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational interfaces.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working for an IPP, power developer, or owner/operator organization.
  • Experience with simple-cycle and/or combined-cycle power generation projects.
  • Understanding of HRSG and steam-cycle integration.
  • Experience with gas turbine technology selection and performance evaluation.
  • Knowledge of decarbonization technologies, including hydrogen blending and carbon capture readiness.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred.
  • Field commissioning, startup, performance testing, or troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience supporting power generation for data center applications.

Core Competencies

  • Owner's engineering mindset and strong technical accountability
  • Gas turbine and balance-of-plant expertise
  • EPC and OEM technical oversight
  • Equipment procurement and specification development
  • Project development and technology evaluation
  • Regulatory and air permitting knowledge
  • Strong commercial and contract awareness
  • Technical risk identification and mitigation
  • Ability to balance innovation with practical project execution
  • Strong communication with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders
  • Ability to operate effectively across development, engineering, construction, and operations teams

job.title: Senior Contracts & Procurement Manager
job.description:
Senior Contracts & Procurement Manager

Hydrogen Group is hiring on behalf of a confidential client operating in the power generation and energy infrastructure sector. This organization develops and delivers large-scale power generation projects supporting data centers and other high-demand energy users.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Contracts & Procurement Manager to lead the sourcing, procurement, and contracting activities associated with major capital projects in an EPC environment.

This individual will oversee the procurement of engineering services, long-lead equipment, materials, and contractor packages from the initial sourcing strategy through contract award and ongoing administration during project execution. The role combines strategic sourcing expertise with hands-on project delivery and requires close coordination across technical, commercial, and project teams.

The successful candidate will help ensure critical equipment and services are secured at competitive commercial terms, meet required quality and compliance standards, and support project schedules and overall delivery objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Competitive Tendering

  • Lead competitive sourcing events for engineering services, equipment, materials, and construction or contractor packages.

  • Manage the full RFQ/RFP process, including preparing solicitation documents, issuing bid packages, coordinating bidder questions, and evaluating submitted proposals.

  • Identify and assess potential suppliers and contractors based on technical capabilities, commercial terms, capacity, and project requirements.

  • Develop bid analyses, comparison tools, and supplier evaluation summaries to support well-documented award decisions.

  • Create and maintain competitive tension among qualified suppliers to achieve favorable pricing and commercial conditions.

  • Conduct supplier and market research to evaluate pricing trends, manufacturing capacity, capabilities, availability, and anticipated lead times.

  • Ensure all sourcing activities are conducted in accordance with procurement policies, quality expectations, and ethical business practices.

Contracts & Commercial Management

  • Lead the development, negotiation, and execution of contracts in partnership with internal legal stakeholders and external suppliers.

  • Ensure agreements clearly define scope, commercial terms, responsibilities, deliverables, and project requirements.

  • Manage purchase orders, service agreements, contract modifications, and amendments throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Coordinate with Project Controls and Legal to maintain visibility into contract status, approvals, and outstanding actions.

  • Maintain complete and organized contract documentation, correspondence, and executed agreements in SharePoint in an audit-ready format.

Procurement Planning & Project Coordination

  • Develop procurement strategies and execution plans that align with project budgets, schedules, milestones, and delivery requirements.

  • Partner with Engineering, Construction, and Project Management teams to establish scopes of work, technical specifications, and supplier requirements.

  • Work closely with Project Controls to develop procurement schedules, sourcing trackers, and equipment or material delivery reporting.

  • Support supply chain planning initiatives that align procurement activities with broader business and project objectives.

  • Maintain visibility across procurement milestones and ensure potential issues are identified early.

Cost, Schedule & Supply Chain Risk Management

  • Monitor market conditions and lead times for critical equipment and materials, particularly items with extended manufacturing or delivery cycles.

  • Identify and communicate procurement-related risks that could affect project schedules.

  • Gather and maintain market intelligence from supplier quotations, market assessments, and other available data to support estimating and lead-time planning.

  • Perform pricing analysis and benchmarking to validate supplier proposals and identify cost-saving opportunities.

  • Develop recommendations to mitigate procurement and supply chain risks and protect project delivery timelines.

  • Track procurement performance, supplier delivery results, realized savings, and other relevant KPIs to support continuous improvement.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a key point of contact between internal project stakeholders and external suppliers and contractors.

  • Coordinate closely with Engineering, Construction, Accounting, Project Controls, and Legal throughout the procurement and contracting process.

  • Manage supplier communications and ensure vendors provide required responses, documentation, and deliverables on schedule.

  • Develop and maintain productive supplier relationships that encourage collaboration, reliability, and innovation.

  • Support supplier onboarding by coordinating required documentation, including tax forms, payment information, confidentiality agreements, and insurance records, with internal Accounting teams.

  • Lead supplier performance discussions and lessons-learned reviews and support improvements based on identified opportunities.

Process Improvement & Strategic Value Creation

  • Support sourcing and contracting approaches designed to improve supply chain flexibility, commercial value, and long-term resilience.

  • Maintain accurate tracking of sourcing activity, procurement pipelines, material deliveries, and key project milestones.

  • Contribute to the implementation and improvement of digital procurement tools and processes that increase efficiency and visibility.

  • Support inclusive and sustainable sourcing practices, including engagement with diverse and community-based suppliers when appropriate.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in procurement, contracts, supply chain, or commercial management within power generation, renewable energy, construction, EPC, oil & gas, or a closely related industry.

  • Demonstrated experience leading competitive sourcing and tendering activities for engineering services, materials, equipment, and contractor packages from scope development through supplier selection and award.

  • Strong knowledge of EPC procurement practices, commercial contracting, supplier management, and contract negotiation.

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

  • Advanced experience using Microsoft Excel and SharePoint.

  • Experience working within an ERP or project management system such as SAP, Oracle, Procore, Sage, or a similar platform.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Project is preferred.

  • Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and project coordination skills.

  • Demonstrated commercial judgment and strategic sourcing capabilities, including the ability to create and manage effective supplier competition.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and support several projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical, financial, legal, and project delivery teams.

  • High attention to detail with a strong commitment to quality, compliance, and accurate documentation.

  • Ability to adapt quickly as project priorities, schedules, and business needs evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is preferred but not required:

  • Experience supporting power generation projects serving data centers or other large-load energy users.

  • Familiarity with long-lead power generation equipment and related supply markets, including turbines, generators, transformers, and switchgear.

  • Professional certification in procurement or supply chain management, such as CIPS or CPSM.

Additional Information

This position may provide procurement and contracting support across multiple power generation projects at the same time. Occasional travel to supplier facilities and project sites may be required.

The SAP Security / GRC Consultant will be responsible for performing audit testing, addressing and mitigating audit findings, implementing SAP user access controls, and supporting security and compliance initiatives across SAP systems. job.title: Data Consultant - Data Remediation and Master Data
job.description:
Data Consultant – Data Remediation & Master Data



Day rate contract

Initial 3 Months

Sydney | Hybrid – 2 Days Onsite



The Opportunity

· We’re partnering with a retail organisation on a high-priority data remediation initiative supporting several major digital and operational transformation programs.

· The organisation is investing heavily in AI-enabled forecasting and operational optimisation, but legacy data quality issues across its store technology ecosystem need to be addressed before the broader program can progress.

· We’re looking for a senior, hands-on Data Consultant who can come in, diagnose the current data landscape, identify root causes and establish a prioritised roadmap for remediation.

· This is not purely a technical SQL role. You’ll need to understand master data, retail operations and how data moves across interconnected systems




Responsibilities

· Lead a detailed assessment of data quality issues across legacy retail and operational systems.

· Perform data profiling, mapping and analysis to identify outdated, inconsistent or inaccurate records.

· Conduct root-cause analysis, identifying not just where data issues exist but why they are occurring.

· Produce a detailed diagnosis report and establish a prioritised remediation backlog.

· Trace data end-to-end across multiple upstream and downstream systems.

· Work hands-on within systems, including running test transactions and validating how data is created, transformed and consumed.

· Analyse complex Master Data structures, including product, recipe, inventory and operational data.



Skillset

· Strong experience in data remediation, data quality and Master Data Management.

· Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins and analysis across multiple tables and datasets.

· Experience investigating and resolving data quality issues across interconnected systems.

· Strong understanding of data profiling, mapping, validation and root-cause analysis.

· Experience within retail, FMCG, convenience, fuel or another high-volume multi-site environment.

· Understanding of how product, inventory and operational data flows through a retail technology ecosystem.

· A genuinely hands-on approach – you'll be comfortable getting into systems, interrogating data and tracing issues rather than simply managing the work.

· Strong stakeholder management skills across both technical and business teams.

Hydrogen Group is recruiting an experienced Project Manager – Pipeline & Facilities for a 6–12 month contract opportunity in Colorado.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of capital projects across midstream pipeline and facility infrastructure, managing delivery from initial engineering and design through procurement, construction, commissioning and close-out.

Projects vary in scale and complexity, and we're interested in Project Managers who can demonstrate genuine ownership of project scope, budget and schedule.

Candidates can come from natural gas, crude oil or NGL infrastructure – experience across all three is not required.

What you'll be doing

As a Project Manager – Pipeline & Facilities, you'll lead multidisciplinary teams and coordinate engineering, contractors, vendors and operational stakeholders to successfully deliver capital projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Manage pipeline and facilities capital projects from development through execution and close-out

job.title: Electronics Lab Technician
job.description:
Electronics Lab Technician

LOCATION: Irvine, CA

DURATION: 6 months contract

PAY: 30-35 USD per hour



Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will support reliability and manufacturing testing of automotive electrical hardware, including Level 3+ ADAS, telematics, infotainment, battery management systems, and zonal Electronic Control Units (ECUs). Key responsibilities include:

· Supporting hardware bring-up, reliability testing, and manufacturing testing activities.

· Operating software interfaces and automated test equipment to exercise and validate electrical hardware.

· Setting up, calibrating, and operating thermal and vibration chambers.

· Troubleshooting test failures and determining whether issues are related to the device under test (DUT), test equipment, harnesses, or test setup.

· Supporting the development, commissioning, and validation of automated test systems.

· Reviewing and documenting test results, failures, and root-cause findings.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

· Operate software user interfaces to control test equipment during hardware bring-up and testing.

· Validate system functionality using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power analyzers, power supplies, and digital multimeters.

· Set up and operate thermal and vibration chambers for environmental testing.

· Perform calibration and mechanical setup of chambers, chillers, fixtures, and associated test equipment.

· Troubleshoot and root-cause failures involving DUTs, test equipment, electrical harnesses, and test fixtures.

· Perform hands-on electrical testing and hardware validation.

· Build and support automated test equipment (ATE) and industrial automation systems.

· Support commissioning and validation of new test systems.

· Perform circuit board modifications, including component rework, soldering, and de-soldering.

· Read and interpret electrical schematics, drawings, and manufacturer datasheets.

· Build first-article test systems and redline schematics as required.

· Document test procedures, test results, equipment issues, and failure investigations.

· Support reliability and manufacturing testing at internal facilities, external laboratories, and contract manufacturing facilities.

· Understand and apply EVT, DVT, and PVT development processes and tester validation practices.

· Perform basic calculations related to control and ramp rates to determine required test profile durations.

Knowledge & Skills:

· Strong hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to read and understand electrical and digital schematics.

· Understanding of basic digital electronic components and circuit functions.

· Experience operating laboratory test equipment, including oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and power analyzers.

· Knowledge of thermal and vibration chamber operation and setup.

· Experience with chambers, chillers, fixtures, and mechanical test setups.

· Understanding of automated test equipment and industrial automation systems.

· Ability to troubleshoot DUT, test equipment, harness, and fixture failures.

· Strong documentation and technical communication skills.

· Ability to analyze test data and clearly communicate test results.

· Understanding of hardware development cycles, including EVT, DVT, and PVT.

· Knowledge of tester validation and test-system commissioning.

· Ability to use power tools and perform mechanical assembly.

· Experience with soldering, de-soldering, and circuit board rework.

· Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

· Ability to work effectively with engineering leads, technicians, vendors, and cross-functional teams.

· Hands-on approach with the ability to proactively identify and resolve gaps in test setups.

· Proficiency with Microsoft and Google productivity applications, including spreadsheets, word processing, and presentations.

Education & Experience:

· Technical degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

· 5+ years of experience building automated test equipment (ATE) or industrial automation systems.

· Experience performing electrical testing using standard laboratory equipment.

· Experience with thermal and/or vibration test chambers.

· Experience with electrical schematics, drawings, and manufacturer datasheets.

· Experience with soldering and circuit board rework.

· Experience using power tools and performing mechanical assembly.

· Experience supporting hardware bring-up, reliability testing, manufacturing testing, or test-system commissioning preferred.

· Automotive electronics or ECU testing experience is a plus.

· Experience working with ADAS, telematics, infotainment, battery management, or zonal ECU hardware is a plus.

job.title: Senior Test Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced ETL Tester to join our technology and data team in Sydney. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, integrity, and reliability of data as it moves between source systems, data warehouses, and downstream applications.

This role is suited to someone with strong experience in ETL/data warehouse testing, particularly within financial services, banking, insurance, or other highly regulated environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts for ETL and data migration projects.
  • Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes across multiple source and target systems.
  • Perform source-to-target data validation, reconciliation, completeness, and integrity testing.
  • Validate complex data transformations, business rules, calculations, and data mappings.
  • Conduct functional, regression, integration, system, and data quality testing.
  • Write and execute complex SQL queries to validate data across databases and data warehouse environments.
  • Identify, investigate, document, and track data defects through to resolution.
  • Work closely with developers, data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand requirements and resolve data issues.
  • Validate financial calculations, transactions, balances, reporting data, and other critical datasets where applicable.
  • Support testing across data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, batch processes, and downstream reporting platforms.
  • Contribute to test automation and continuous improvement of data testing practices.
  • Ensure testing activities align with financial services regulatory, governance, security, and audit requirements.

Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in ETL testing, data warehouse testing, or data quality testing.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations, subqueries, and data reconciliation.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT concepts and data warehouse architectures.
  • Experience with tools such as Informatica, Talend, SSIS, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or similar.
  • Experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data mapping, transformation rules, source-to-target validation, and reconciliation.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar.
  • Understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Desired Experience

  • Experience in banking, lending, payments, wealth management, insurance, or financial markets is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of financial data, transactions, customer/account data, regulatory reporting, risk data, or financial reconciliation processes will be advantageous
  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience testing data pipelines in Databricks or Snowflake.
  • Knowledge of Python or another scripting language for test automation.
  • Experience with API testing and batch-processing validation.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and automated testing frameworks.
  • Understanding of data governance, data lineage, and data quality frameworks

Position Summary

Our client is a medical device manufacturer with clean room production operations. The main function of this technician role is to set up and execute feasibility studies, experiments, and tests — both creating and following established protocols — to develop findings for the validation and improvement of equipment and manufacturing processes/methods based on engineering principles. This role analyzes results, makes recommendations, and develops reports for Engineering review, and operates a variety of test equipment to assess characteristics of the manufacturing environment.

  • Identify potential improvement opportunities and propose solutions to optimize process and/or equipment (e.g., re-design/design of basic equipment, tools, fixtures, etc.) to improve manufacturing processes, for Engineering review.
  • Provide coaching and guidance to technicians.







Education/Experience

  • H.S. Diploma or equivalent
  • 2-4 years of experience required







Knowledge/Skills

  • Excellent computer skills required, including experience with MS Office Suite; ERP/MRP systems experience preferred
  • Ability to read, comprehend, write and speak English, and good communication skills required
  • Knowledge of and adherence to the client's Environmental Health and Safety and Quality guidelines as they relate to department clean room medical device manufacturing
  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing and Good Documentation Practices supporting a medical device environment
  • Strict attention to detail
  • Ability to provide feedback in a professional, direct, and tactful manner
  • Must be able to work in a team environment and with minimum supervision
  • Proven success adhering to project schedules and managing small projects
  • Substantial knowledge of validation and improvement of automated equipment
  • Ability to troubleshoot manufacturing equipment
  • Knowledge of material compatibility in the proposed use environment

job.description:
QUALITY ENGINEER II

LOCATION: Draper, UT

SCHEDULE: Standard

DURATION: 9-Month Contract

MAX PAY RATE: $37-42/hr.



Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will support quality assurance and manufacturing quality activities within a regulated medical device environment. Key responsibilities include:

· Supporting equipment, process, and test method validation activities, including IQ, OQ, PQ, and TMV.

· Conducting root cause investigations and supporting nonconformance and CAPA activities.

· Ensuring products and processes comply with applicable FDA, ISO 13485, GMP, and internal Quality Management System requirements.

· Supporting manufacturing, engineering, supplier quality, regulatory, operations, and quality teams in resolving quality issues.

· Analyzing quality and manufacturing data to identify trends, recurring defects, and opportunities for improvement.

· Supporting continuous improvement initiatives focused on process capability, defect reduction, compliance, and operational excellence.

Essential Duties and Job Functions

· Lead and support equipment, process, and test method validation activities, including development, execution, and approval of IQ, OQ, PQ, and TMV protocols and reports.

· Ensure validation activities are performed in accordance with FDA, ISO 13485, GMP, and internal quality requirements.

· Investigate product and process nonconformances and perform root cause analysis using methodologies such as 5 Why, Fishbone, Fault Tree Analysis, and other quality tools.

· Author, review, and maintain NCR, CAPA, deviation, validation, and technical documentation.

· Facilitate CAPA investigations, identify corrective and preventive actions, and verify the effectiveness of implemented solutions.

· Support Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supplier Quality teams in resolving quality issues and reducing recurring defects.

· Participate in risk management activities, including PFMEA reviews, risk assessments, and implementation of risk mitigation strategies.

· Analyze quality and manufacturing data using statistical techniques to identify trends, adverse conditions, and process improvement opportunities.

· Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections by providing technical documentation and evidence of compliance.

· Review and approve changes through change control processes and assess potential quality impacts to validated systems and processes.

· Develop and revise quality procedures, work instructions, validation plans, and related Quality Management System documentation.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on process capability, defect reduction, compliance, and operational excellence.

· Provide quality engineering support for new product introductions, manufacturing transfers, and process improvements.

Knowledge & Skills

· Hands-on experience executing and documenting IQ, OQ, PQ, and TMV activities.

· Strong knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, GMP, and medical device quality system requirements.

· Experience conducting and documenting root cause investigations and implementing effective CAPAs.

· Working knowledge of NCR, CAPA, change control, deviation, and risk management processes.

· Understanding of validation lifecycle management, including protocol development, execution, and report generation.

· Working knowledge of statistical analysis tools and quality methodologies, including SPC, Minitab, DOE, Gage R&R, and process capability analysis.

· Experience with PFMEA, risk assessments, and structured problem-solving methodologies.

· Proficiency in reviewing technical drawings, specifications, procedures, and validation documentation.

· Strong technical writing and documentation skills.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

· Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects.

· Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to compliance and product quality.

· Ability to independently manage investigations, validations, projects, and quality system activities.

· Ability to build productive working relationships across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Operations.

· Strong teamwork, problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.

Education & Experience

· Bachelor's degree in Engineering required.

· 2–4 years of relevant quality engineering experience required.

· Experience in a regulated medical device manufacturing environment preferred.

· Experience with equipment, process, and test method validation preferred.

· Experience with CAPA, NCR, nonconformance investigations, risk management, and change control preferred.

· Familiarity with FDA, ISO 13485, GMP, and Quality Management System requirements preferred.

job.title: Financial Crime Architecture Lead
job.description:
Financial Crime Architecture Lead

Location: London (2/3 days per week on site)
Salary: up to £120,000 plus bonus and excellent benefits package
Employment Type: Permanent

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Financial Crime Architecture Lead to own and shape the future-state technology architecture supporting Financial Crime capabilities across a leading financial services organisation.

This is a senior architecture position with responsibility for creating a more unified Financial Crime technology ecosystem across AML, transaction monitoring, screening, onboarding, risk, suitability and investment mandate processes.

You will define how platforms including ComplyAdvantage, OCS, Salesforce and Snowflake work together, bringing greater consistency across data, workflow, decisioning, case management and user experience.

The role combines Financial Crime domain expertise with enterprise and solution architecture, data and integration architecture, platform strategy and emerging AI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end target architecture for the Financial Crime technology landscape.
  • Define the strategic architecture across transaction monitoring, AML, sanctions and PEP screening, adverse media, onboarding, risk rating and case management.
  • Create a unified architecture across data, workflow, decisioning and user experience, reducing fragmented processes and duplicated data.
  • Assess and rationalise the existing technology landscape, including ComplyAdvantage, OCS, Salesforce, Snowflake and supporting platforms.
  • Determine where capabilities should be integrated, consolidated, enhanced or retired.
  • Define integration architecture including REST APIs, event-driven patterns, data contracts, message queues and near-real-time data flows.
  • Shape the architecture for AI-enabled Financial Crime capabilities, including alert optimisation, investigation summarisation, adverse media triage and anomaly detection.
  • Ensure AI and data capabilities are explainable, auditable and appropriate for a highly regulated environment.
  • Establish architecture standards across security, resilience, data lineage, model governance, privacy and regulatory traceability.
  • Work closely with Risk, Compliance, Operations, Product, Data, Cyber and Technology teams to translate Financial Crime requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  • Support technology and vendor selection, assessing capability, integration complexity, data coverage, AI readiness, cost and long-term strategic fit.
  • Act as the senior architecture authority within programme governance and ensure tactical delivery remains aligned with the longer-term Financial Crime strategy.

About You

We are looking for an established architecture leader with experience delivering complex technology change within financial services

You will ideally bring:

  • Significant Enterprise, Solution or Domain Architecture experience.
  • Strong experience within Financial Crime, AML, KYC, Risk or Compliance.
  • Good understanding of AML, sanctions, PEP/adverse media screening, transaction monitoring, risk rating, alert management and case management.
  • Experience defining target-state architectures and multi-year technology roadmaps.
  • Strong knowledge of data and integration architecture, including APIs, event-driven architecture and modern data platforms.
  • Experience with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud or comparable CRM/workflow platforms.
  • Experience with Snowflake or comparable modern analytical/data platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, security and engineering governance.
  • Experience evaluating and integrating third-party Financial Crime or Risk technology platforms.
  • An understanding of AI/ML and GenAI architecture, particularly within regulated environments.
  • Knowledge of responsible AI principles including explainability, human-in-the-loop controls, model governance and auditability.
  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders across Technology, Risk, Compliance and Operations.

Technical Environment

Exposure to some of the following would be particularly relevant:

Salesforce Financial Services Cloud | Snowflake | ComplyAdvantage | OCS | SQL | Python | REST APIs | Event-Driven Architecture | Cloud | CI/CD | DevSecOps | AI/ML | GenAI | LLMs | RAG | Data Governance | Data Lineage


If you have the above experience please apply immediately

Summary

Our client, a large regulated utility, is seeking an IT Project Manager V to own and operate an integrated technology portfolio spanning multiple workstreams. This role sits at the intersection of business and IT, driving portfolio-level planning, financial reconciliation, risk and governance discipline, and executive-ready reporting. The successful candidate will design and run a durable operating model — including RACI, governance calendar, and escalation paths — while coordinating closely with the organization's existing PMO structure, without taking over product or workstream delivery accountability.


Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will manage and support an integrated technology portfolio spanning Customer Service and IT. Key responsibilities include:

  • Own the integrated portfolio workplan, including milestones, dependencies, critical path, stage-gate readiness, and ownership.
  • Consolidate baseline budget, forecast, actuals, contingency, and variance explanations; reconcile the Customer Service view with IT reporting.
  • Maintain integrated risks, issues, actions, decisions, dependencies, and changes with owners, dates, escalation thresholds, and aging.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly portfolio rollups and concise, decision-ready materials for senior leadership and governance forums.

  • Design and maintain the operating model, RACI, governance calendar, escalation paths, and boundary with the organization's existing PMO.
  • Support business and IT project-lead pairings without taking over product or workstream delivery accountability.
  • Create a durable PMO package with templates, cadence, decision history, and handoff instructions.

  • Apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help maximize the benefit of IT system investments.
  • Meet with decision makers, systems owners, and end users to define business, financial, and operations requirements and systems goals.
  • Identify and resolve systems issues in support of portfolio delivery.

Knowledge and Skills

Required:

  • Ownership of an integrated portfolio with at least three meaningful technology workstreams.
  • Joint business and IT PMO experience.
  • Portfolio financial management, forecasting, reconciliation, and value tracking.
  • Risk, issue, decision, dependency, and change-control discipline.
  • Executive communication that converts complexity into clear decisions, consequences, and next steps.
  • Multi-vendor technology-transformation experience.
  • Ability to drive closure across senior stakeholders without direct authority.

Desired:

  • Familiarity with enterprise portfolio tools and governance forums comparable to a large utility environment.
  • Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on artifact creation.

Education and Experience

Bachelor's Degree in a relevant business or technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. Three to five years of relevant experience.

Duration: 4-month contract

Pay Range: $86–91/hr

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM with flexibility



Summary

Our client's Core Data team builds and scales the data platform and analytics capabilities that power decision-making across the organization. Within Core Data, the Vehicle Catalog team owns the vehicle domain — ingesting, curating, and organizing vehicle data for analytics, ML, and BI use cases relied on by hundreds of stakeholders across dozens of domain teams. The team is migrating the Vehicle Catalog to a new Databricks account while simultaneously building out a new vehicle catalog on that platform. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help refactor and move existing ETL/ELT and analytics pipelines into the new environment, migrate the underlying data, and validate that everything lands correctly. This is hands-on migration work alongside the engineering team on well-defined pipelines with clear acceptance criteria, with related migration requests — including dashboard and reporting migrations — picked up as they arise.



Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will manage and support data migration projects within the Core Data department. Key responsibilities include:

  • Working with a Staff Data Engineer to understand the migration plan, sequence work against it, and provide regular progress updates.
  • Refactoring existing ETL/ELT code written in PySpark, DABs, and dbt from the current Databricks environment to meet the patterns and standards of the new account.
  • Migrating data pipelines and their underlying datasets, including backfills, and validating parity between source and target.
  • Building and running reconciliation checks — row counts, schema conformance, freshness, completeness — to confirm migrated data matches the legacy environment.
  • Migrating dashboards and downstream reporting assets to point at the new datasets, coordinating with the analysts who own them.
  • Updating orchestration, scheduling, alerting, and runbooks so migrated pipelines are supportable after cutover.
  • Troubleshooting pipeline failures and data discrepancies during and after cutover.
  • Documenting what was migrated, what changed, and anything the team needs to know to own it going forward.
  • Taking on adjacent migration and data engineering requests as the program evolves.



Essential Job Duties and Job Functions

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or Software Engineering working with production data systems.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and Python for building scalable data pipelines and transformations.
  • Hands-on experience building ELT pipelines using modern cloud data platforms (Databricks experience required).
  • Experience building robust testing frameworks for data migration (completeness, quality, etc.).
  • Deep experience with dbt, including model development, testing, documentation, and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience designing and operating production-grade data pipelines with monitoring and observability.
  • Prior data or platform migration experience.



Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong familiarity with AI development tools such as Claude Code or Devin for the software development process.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to partner with engineering teams, analysts, and operational stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Fivetran connector management and ingestion architecture (nice-to-have).
  • Experience with data contracts and schema governance (nice-to-have).
  • Knowledge of streaming or near-real-time data pipelines (nice-to-have).



Education and Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years in procurement, ideally with FMCG experience under your belt
  • A track record of end-to-end category ownership — packaging and/or commodities specifically
  • Confidence negotiating and managing contracts with suppliers of all sizes
  • Comfort operating in a multi-site, complex business

  • The communication chops to talk shop with a site operator and an executive in the same day

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI tools can sharpen your reporting and decision-making

Why This Role

You'll get autonomy, a seat at the table with senior leadership, and a category that genuinely matters to the business. If you like owning outcomes rather than just processing purchase orders, this is built for you.
