We are seeking a Senior Process Control Engineer to provide technical leadership in process automation, control system design, commissioning, and continuous improvement initiatives within a manufacturing environment. This role will serve as a subject matter expert for process control systems, support capital projects, troubleshoot complex automation issues, and partner with engineering and production teams to improve reliability, efficiency, and overall process performance.



Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Process Controls Engineering

  • Lead the design, configuration, testing, and commissioning of complex control systems for new and modified manufacturing processes.
  • Develop and maintain control system standards, programming practices, documentation requirements, and automation architectures.
  • Evaluate and recommend control hardware and software solutions to support operational and business objectives.
  • Troubleshoot advanced process control issues, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

Capital Projects & Engineering Support

  • Lead capital projects from initial scope development and cost justification through control design, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and site commissioning.
  • Develop project schedules, coordinate vendors and contractors, manage deliverables, and communicate project updates to engineering and site leadership.
  • Review and approve engineering documentation, including P&IDs, control narratives, functional specifications, cause-and-effect matrices, and as-built documentation.

  • Partner with Production and Process Development teams to improve automation, efficiency, data collection, reporting, and process reliability.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing downtime, improving equipment performance, and increasing operational efficiency.

Training, Documentation & Compliance

  • Develop and deliver training programs for operators on automated systems, control processes, and operational best practices.
  • Ensure all control system activities comply with site GMP requirements, change control procedures, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Support safety, quality, and compliance initiatives through participation in investigations, corrective actions, and process improvement efforts.
  • Maintain accurate engineering documentation in alignment with good documentation practices (GDP) and quality management systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, or related discipline).
  • 5–7+ years of experience in process controls, automation engineering, or related manufacturing environments.
  • 5–7+ years of experience managing engineering projects, including planning, execution, and commissioning.
  • Hands-on experience with PLC and/or DCS platforms such as Rockwell, Siemens, Emerson DeltaV, or Honeywell.
  • Experience leading automation projects, including scope development, cost estimation, testing, and startup/commissioning activities.
  • Strong understanding of process instrumentation, including flow, pressure, temperature, level, and analytical measurement systems.
  • Experience with control loop tuning, troubleshooting, and optimization.
  • Knowledge of GMP, quality systems, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven problem-solving skills with experience leading RCA investigations and implementing long-term solutions.
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment, including equipment inspections, troubleshooting activities, climbing stairs/ladders, and wearing required PPE.
  • Flexibility to support shutdowns, startups, and other critical operational activities as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with biotech, pharmaceutical, specialty chemical, or bioprocess manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with bioprocess automation, fermentation systems, or BioFacility operations.
  • Knowledge of SCADA systems, historian platforms (such as OSIsoft PI), and MES integrations.
  • Familiarity with ISA-88 batch control standards and ISA-99/IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity standards.
  • Experience with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for electronic records and electronic signatures.
  • Experience with process simulation tools, operator training systems (OTS), or automation training platforms.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or progress toward obtaining licensure.
  • Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading technical teams.

We are seeking an experienced Clinical Program Sourcing & Contract Management Manager to lead end-to-end study-level contracting for complex clinical vendor categories supporting global Phase I–IV clinical trials.




This role is responsible for managing the contracting process for high-value clinical service providers, including CROs, central laboratories, clinical technology vendors, and other strategic functional service categories. Working within established Master Service Agreements (MSAs), the Manager will partner closely with Clinical Operations, Finance, Legal, and Procurement to develop vendor budgets, negotiate Statements of Work (SOWs), manage contract amendments, and ensure timely execution while maintaining compliance with internal governance and regulatory requirements.



Responsibilities

Specification Management & Budget Development

  • Lead the end-to-end specification intake process with Clinical Trial Leads (CTLs) and Study Management Teams for complex vendor categories.
  • Review, validate, and refine study specifications to ensure alignment with protocol requirements and operational objectives.
  • Develop detailed vendor budgets in collaboration with preferred vendors, ensuring alignment with approved pricing frameworks and study scope.
  • Evaluate pricing across approved vendors, assessing cost drivers, service models, and operational considerations.

  • Maintain accurate documentation within contracting systems and document repositories.
  • Support audit readiness through clear documentation and defensible commercial decision-making.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure consistent contract governance and compliance.

Qualifications

  • Experience managing complex clinical vendor categories, including CROs, central laboratories, clinical technology providers, or similar service partners.
  • Strong background in specification development, scope validation, and vendor budget development.
  • Proven experience negotiating pricing, scope, and contract terms within established Master Service Agreement (MSA) frameworks.
  • Thorough understanding of end-to-end clinical trial contracting processes and study start-up timelines.

  • Experience managing vendor performance against contracting timelines and operational milestones.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple complex contracts simultaneously.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on compliance and process governance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Highly Desirable

  • DBT

Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will manage and support a variety of data analytics and reporting initiatives within Electric Distribution Operations. Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead complex electric distribution, Network Management System (NMS), Oracle Utilities Analytics (OUA), and Customer Success data requests by understanding source data relationships, building and refining SQL queries, validating results, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Own recurring outage data audits to identify gaps, trends, and opportunities to improve customer outage notifications, internal processes, data quality, and supporting technology.
  • Design and build reports, dashboards, and data views using outage, customer, operational, and other relevant data sources to support leadership decisions and operational performance monitoring.
  • Support development of internal and external outage trackers, including integration with cloud-hosted components or AWS-based environments where applicable.
  • Analyze Customer Success, customer outage notification, and external outage map data to identify opportunities to improve customer experience, including developing options and recommendations related to crew status information and other customer-facing outage map enhancements.

Essential Job Duties and Job Functions

  • Independently analyze complex operational data sets, reconcile data across systems, identify anomalies, validate results, evaluate options, and translate findings into actionable business insights and recommendations.
  • Lead requirements discussions, document functional or technical specifications, support user acceptance testing, create user-friendly documentation, and advise stakeholders on data-driven decisions.
  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders, ask thoughtful questions, and provide clear, data-driven recommendations.
  • Prioritize data accuracy, quality, and reliable outcomes across all reporting and analysis work.
  • Understand how data, applications, Customer Success priorities, and operational processes work together to support reliable operations and improve the customer experience.
  • Seek opportunities to enhance processes, reporting, and operational performance on an ongoing basis.
  • Ramp up quickly, organize work, manage ambiguity, and move analysis forward with limited day-to-day direction.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong analytical and SQL skills, with the ability to work independently across complex operational data sets, validate results, identify anomalies, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Utility operations or outage management experience recommended (not required), particularly familiarity with outage management, customer outage notifications, external outage map analytics, reliability data, Network Management System (NMS), SQL Developer, or related utility operations data.
  • Clear, executive-ready communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and influence decisions through data-driven insights.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational data models, and Oracle Database concepts; experience with Oracle tools, Power BI, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with PL/SQL, XML, Power Query, Power BI data modeling, DAX, Microsoft Fabric, cloud data warehousing, or AWS-based data environments preferred.

Candidate Profile: We are seeking a senior-level contractor who is a strong analytical problem solver, Customer Success-focused, data-driven, collaborative, detail-oriented, a systems thinker, self-directed, and committed to continuous improvement.

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma required; Bachelor's degree not required.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business systems analysis, database development, BI/reporting, software development, or application/data support roles, preferably supporting complex operational systems. Candidates with 7+ years of highly relevant utility, outage management, customer operations, or operational analytics experience may also be considered.
  • Senior-level experience developing reports, dashboards, data extracts, or analytics using SQL, Oracle tools, Power BI, or similar platforms.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Project Manager – Engineering & Construction (E&C)

Location: Juno Beach, FL

Schedule: Standard Office Hours (EST)

Duration: 12-Month Contract

Pay Rate: $37-42/hour

Position Overview

We are seeking a Project Manager with an engineering background to join the Value Engineering Team within the Engineering & Construction (E&C) business unit. This role is responsible for managing innovative engineering initiatives from concept and design through implementation, supporting a portfolio of Solar PV and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong project management experience, a technical engineering foundation, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage engineering projects from conceptual design through commissioning and implementation.
  • Lead project planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and execution activities.
  • Coordinate with suppliers and vendors to identify product improvements and cost reduction opportunities.
  • Provide technical input and assess project feasibility during implementation.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Develop and maintain project documentation, status reports, and stakeholder communications.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by recommending process enhancements and best practices.
  • Attend industry conferences and build relationships with suppliers and vendors to identify emerging technologies and solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience managing engineering projects from design through implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of project management principles, including:
    • Scope management
    • Schedule management
    • Budget management
    • Risk management
  • Knowledge of engineering design processes, technical specifications, and implementation practices.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
  • High level of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and enthusiastic about continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), or other power generation projects.
  • Understanding of utility-scale renewable energy project development.
  • Knowledge of project valuation and financial metrics, including:
    • Net Present Value (NPV)
    • Internal Rate of Return (IRR)
    • Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE)
  • Experience with data analysis and analytics.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate is an engineering professional who combines strong technical knowledge with proven project management skills. They are collaborative, detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of driving engineering projects from concept through successful implementation while supporting innovation and value engineering initiatives.
